# WISMILAK

## Collaboration for Better Engagement

Tahun 2022 masih menjadi tahun yang penuh tantangan bagi banyak dunia usaha, termasuk bagi PT Wismilak Inti Makmur Tbk (Wismilak). Selain adanya kenaikan tarif cukai dan harga jual, tantangan ini juga terjadi karena tingkat prediktabilitas peraturan yang dinamis dan terbatasnya investasi yang ada. Namun, terlepas dari tantangan tersebut, Wismilak mampu terus meningkatkan kinerjanya dengan mempererat kolaborasi, sinergi, dan pelibatan semua pemangku kepentingan, baik internal maupun eksternal. Kami mencatat capaian kinerja yang memenuhi target dan kami memastikan adanya nilai tambah bagi semua pemangku kepentingan.

The year 2022 was still a challenging year for many industries, including for PT Wismilak Inti Makmur Tbk (Wismilak). Beside the increasing excise and selling price, the dynamic predictability of regulations and the limited investment were some of the challenges faced by the Company. However, amidst these challenges, Wismilak successfully improved its performance through collaboration, synergy, and engagement of internal and external stakeholders. We recorded performance achievement that fulfilled the target, and we ensure added value for all stakeholders.

## Pernyataan dan Batasan Tanggung Jawab

Laporan Keberlanjutan ini diterbitkan oleh PT Wismilak Inti Makmur Tbk atau selanjutnya disebut "Wismilak". "Perseroan", dan/atau "Perusahaan" yang menjalankan usaha di bidang produksi dan pemasaran rokok kretek premium. Laporan ini memuat pernyataan posisi keuangan dan hasil operasi, proyeksi, rencana, strategi, kebijakan, dan tujuan Perseroan, yang digolongkan sebagai pernyataan ke depan dalam pelaksanaan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku, kecuali hal-hal yang bersifat historis. Pernyataan-pernyataan tersebut memiliki prospek risiko, ketidakpastian, serta dapat mengakibatkan perkembangan aktual secara material berbeda dari yang dilaporkan.

Pernyataan-pernyataan prospektif dalam laporan ini dibuat berdasarkan berbagai asumsi mengenai kondisi terkini dan kondisi mendatang serta lingkungan bisnis, di mana Perseroan menjalankan kegiatan usaha. Perseroan tidak menjamin bahwa dokumen-dokumen yang telah dipastikan keabsahannya akan membawa hasil-hasil tertentu sesuai harapan.

## Mr. Willy Walla

President Commissioner

Seluruh insan Wismilak berduka cita atas berpulangnya Bapak Willy Walla selaku Komisaris Utama PT Wismilak Inti Makmur Tbk (2012 - 2022), pada 23 September 2022. Almarhum pernah menjabat sebagai Direktur Utama Perseroan (1994 - 2012), Presiden Direktur anak perusahaan Perseroan, PT Gelora Djaja (1986-2007) dan PT Gawih Djaja (1983-2007).

Bapak Willy Walla yang lahir pada 11 April 1949 di Donggala juga merupakan penggagas dan pendiri dari Wismilak Foundation. Beliau adalah tokoh yang memiliki kepedulian dan aktif di berbagai kegiatan sosial, juga merupakan sosok yang mendedikasikan prioritas serta pemikirannya untuk Indonesia.

Dedikasi, nilai kebaikan, serta komitmen beliau dalam membangun Wismilak dan Wismilak Foundation akan terus kami bawa dan lanjutkan demi cita-cita Wismilak dalam mencapai spirit 'Bersama Meraih Sukses' untuk seluruh pemangku kepentingan. Rasa duka dan kehilangan, kami manifestasikan dalam semangat kerja, nilai-nilai kebaikan, dan kemanusiaan, sebagaimana tauladan yang kami peroleh dari Almarhum bapak Willy Walla.

Selamat jalan, Pak Willy...

All Wismilak people mourned the passing of Mr Willy Walla as President Commissioner of PT Wismilak Inti Makmur Tbk (2012 - 2022), Tbk, on September 23, 2022. The deceased had served as President Director of the Company (1994 - 2012), President Director of the Company's subsidiary, PT Gelora Djaja (1986-2007) and PT Gawih Djaja (1983-2007).

Mr. Willy Walla who was born on April 11, 1949 in Donggala is also the initiator and founder of the Wismilak Foundation. He is a figure who cares and is active in various social activities, as well as a person who dedicates his priorities and thoughts to Indonesia.

We will continue to carry his dedication, values, and commitment to building Wismilak and the Wismilak Foundation for the sake of Wismilak's goals in achieving the 'Together for Success' for all stakeholders. We manifest our feelings of sorrow and loss in the spirit of work, values of kindness and humanity, as the example from the late Mr. Willy Walla.

Have a peaceful rest, Mr. Willy...

Dear Stakeholders,

Pemangku Kepentingan yang terhormat,

Puji syukur kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Esa, atas rahmat-Nya, kami dapat menyampaikan Laporan Keberlanjutan pada tahun 2022. Laporan ini memberikan gambaran tentang komitmen Wismilak terhadap dukungan pada pencapaian Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan (TPB) di Indonesia.

Di tengah tantangan global yang semakin kompleks dan dinamis, kami tetap memegang teguh nilai-nilai keberlanjutan dan terus untuk mengoptimalkan peluang, serta meminimalkan risiko dalam seluruh aspek bisnis kami. Perusahaan sadar akan pentingnya menerapkan praktik keberlanjutan dalam seluruh kegiatan operasional dengan mengutamakan proses bisnis yang memberikan dampak positif bagi masyarakat dan lingkungan hidup. Seluruh insan Wismilak, termasuk Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris turut mendukung penerapan praktik dan inisiatif keberlanjutan.

## Kebijakan Merespon Tantangan

Makna keberlanjutan bagi kami adalah menjalankan proses bisnis yang berwawasan lingkungan, bertanggung jawab, dan beretika, serta saling bersinergi dengan seluruh rantai pasok. Dalam setiap pengambilan keputusan, Perusahaan memiliki kebijakan yang berkaitan dengan aspek lingkungan, sosial, dan tata kelola (LST) yaitu aspek yang mendukung keberlanjutan. Kebijakan LST ini menjadi dasar untuk merespons tantangan, di antaranya perubahan cuaca yang menjadi salah satu isu lingkungan, kompetensi sumber daya manusia pada aspek sosial, serta perilaku bisnis etis yang sejalan dengan tata kelola perusahaan. Maka, untuk menjawab tantangan ini, Tim Keberlanjutan Wismilak terus memastikan praktik keberlanjutan dalam Perusahaan dilakukan secara maksimal.

Praises be to the Almighty God who has showered us with His blessings and enabled us to deliver this Sustainability Report for 2022. This report presents our commitment to supporting the achievement of Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in Indonesia.

In the midst of the complex and dynamic global challenges, we remain to uphold our sustainability principles, capture opportunities, and minimize the risks across our business. The Company acknowledges the importance of sustainability practices across its operations. Therefore, we are prioritizing a business process that delivers positive impacts on the community and the environment. All employees, including the Board of Directors and the Board of Commissioners, support the implementation of sustainability practices and initiatives.

## Policies in Facing Challenges

We regard sustainability as an environmentally conscious, responsible, and ethical business process with synergy across the supply chain. In decision-making process, the Company employs policy on the environmental, social and governance (ESG) aspects that support sustainability. ESG policy is our foundation in facing challenges, including climate change as an environmental issue, human resource competency as a social issue, and ethical business practice in accordance with corporate governance. To tackle these issues, Wismilak Sustainability Task Force ensures excellent implementation of sustainability practices.

Pesan Direksi
Message from Director

Tahun 2022 menjadi tahun pemulihan setelah situasi pandemi COVID-19 mereda, namun berbagai tantangan tetap ada. Perubahan preferensi pelanggan dan gaya hidup menjadi salah satu hal yang perlu dicermati. Kami tetap optimis memperhatikan perubahan ini dan merespon dengan mengembangkan produk baru dan mempererat sinergi sehingga berhasil mencatatkan kinerja yang positif. Capaian ini menjadi dasar pengembangan kami untuk terus memberikan nilai tambah kepada para pemangku kepentingan.

Di sisi lain, isu perubahan iklim semakin dirasakan dan mendorong berbagai pelaku usaha untuk meningkatkan pengelolaan aspek-aspek keberlanjutan. Wismilak merespon tantangan ini dengan berkomitmen melaksanakan Empat Pilar Keberlanjutan yaitu mendorong pertumbuhan bisnis, mengelola dampak lingkungan dengan baik, melakukan kegiatan usaha dengan prioritas kesejahteraan bersama dan berkontribusi pada perekonomian lokal. Perusahaan terus menjaga keseimbangan Pilar Keberlanjutan dengan pengelolaan dampak lingkungan, kesejahteraan bersama, dan kontribusi pada perekonomian lokal.

# Penerapan Kinerja Keberlanjutan

Hingga akhir tahun 2022, kami mencatat pendapatan usaha mencapai Rp3.704,4 miliar, naik sebesar 35,5% dari tahun 2021, atau sebesar Rp970,7 miliar. Kenaikan pendapatan ini sejalan dengan adanya produk baru dan pertumbuhan penjualan rokok sebesar 22% dibanding tahun sebelumnya, atau sebanyak 624,2 juta batang.

Nilai ekonomi yang dihasilkan, didistribusikan kembali untuk pemangku kepentingan, baik kepada karyawan, investor, pemegang saham, pemerintah, dan masyarakat. Perusahaan berkontribusi pada peningkatan kesejahteraan ekonomi setempat, melalui dampak ekonomi secara langsung dan tidak langsung.

Perusahaan juga mencatat kinerja lingkungan dan sosial yang baik melalui pelaksanaan kegiatan-kegiatan yang telah berjalan dari tahun sebelumnya. Kinerja lingkungan, salah satunya ditunjukkan dengan rencana pembangunan pembangkit listrik tenaga surya (PLTS) sebagai sumber energi alternatif ramah lingkungan di kawasan fasilitas produksi Perusahaan. Perencanaan proyek PLTS ini sudah dimulai pada bulan Desember 2022 dan dapat diselesaikan pada tahun 2023. Proyek PLTS ini merupakan respon Perusahaan untuk menggunakan sumber energi baru terbarukan (EBT) dan mengurangi emisi gas rumah kaca (GRK). Selain itu, Perusahaan juga terus meningkatkan kinerjanya dalam efisiensi penggunaan energi dan pengelolaan limbah.

The year 2022 was a recovery year after the COVID-19 pandemic. However, several challenges remained to be faced. Shifts in customer preference and lifestyle become matters of concern. We remain confident while observing this change and respond to the issue by launching new products and strengthening synergy to realize positive performance. This achievement become our foundation to grow and to deliver added values to the stakeholders.

On the other hand, climate change has become significant and driven business players to improve the management of sustainability aspects. Wismilak responds to this challenge through its commitment to implementing Four Sustainability Pillars: encouraging the growth of business activities, managing environmental impacts, conducting business activities prioritizing collective welfare, and contributing to local economy. The Company remains to maintain the balance of its Sustainability Pillars by managing the environmental impacts, collective welfare, and contribution to local economy.

# Sustainability Performance

By the end of 2022, we recorded operating revenue of IDR3,704.4 billion, an increase of 35.5% from 2021, or Rp970.7 billion. This increase in revenue is in line with new products and cigarette sales growth of 22% compared to the previous year, or 624.2 million cigarettes.

The generated economic value was then distributed to the stakeholders, including the employees, investors, shareholders, the government, and the public. The Company contributes to the improvement of local economy through direct and indirect economic impacts.

The Company recorded excellent environmental and social performance through the implementation of programs carried out since the previous year. Our excellent environmental performance is reflected by solar power plant construction plan to serve as an alternative renewable energy source for the Company's production facilities. The project planning has been started in December 2022 and will be finalized in 2023. This project serves as a response in employing new and renewable energy (NEW) to reduce greenhouse gases (GHG) emission. In addition, the Company seeks to improve its performance in terms of energy consumption and waste management.

Perusahaan juga senantiasa melaksanakan berbagai program pemberdayaan masyarakat melalui berbagai program unggulan, antara lain Wismilak BERBAGI dengan salah satu flagship program-nya yaitu program kewirausahaan Diplomat Success Challenge (DSC). ## Strategi Pencapaian Target

Wismilak terus memperkuat komitmen dalam mewujudkan dan mendukung praktik keberlanjutan. Perusahaan melakukan identifikasi dan pengelolaan dampak negatif, serta risiko usaha melalui prosedur dan pengawasan pada sistem tata kelola yang baik. Salah satu strategi yang kami lakukan adalah mempererat kolaborasi dan sinergi melalui berbagai pelibatan dengan pemangku kepentingan.

Perusahaan menjaga setiap rantai pasok yang menjadi kekuatan dalam menjalankan kinerja keberlanjutan. Kami percaya bahwa hubungan yang baik dan saling menguntungkan dengan para pemasok, termasuk masyarakat sekitar yang menjadi pekerja, adalah kunci dalam mencapai target kinerja yang diharapkan. Hal ini juga menjadi dasar bagi pengembangan untuk mempersiapkan prospek usaha di masa depan.

## Apresiasi

Kami mewakili Perusahaan, menyampaikan apresiasi kepada seluruh pemangku kepentingan atas dukungan, kerja sama, dan kepercayaan yang telah diberikan. Perusahaan akan terus mengupayakan yang terbaik melalui collaboration for better engagement dengan seluruh pemangku kepentingan untuk mencapai tujuan bersama. Perusahaan yakin bahwa melalui kerja sama dan kolaborasi yang efektif, kita dapat berkontribusi untuk kemajuan di Indonesia, termasuk memberikan nilai tambah bagi masyarakat, lingkungan, dan ekonomi secara keseluruhan.

In terms of social performance, occupational health and safety (OHS) is one of our main foci in establishing a safe and comfortable working environment for the employees. The Company delivers various community empowerment programs through its leading programs as well, including Wismilak BERBAGI, whose flagship program is known as Diplomat Success Challenge (DSC). As an advanced measure of education and literacy program, the Company supports digitalization through complementary program of coding and robotics training for 160 students. These programs will be carried out and improved in 2023 as well.

## Strategies to Achieve Targets

Wismilak seeks to strengthen its commitment to realizing and supporting sustainability practices. The Company identifies and manages its negative impacts and business risks through the procedures and monitoring of good corporate governance system. One of the strategies that we employ is fostering collaboration and synergy by engaging the stakeholders.

The Company maintain its supply chain as its strength in implementing sustainability. We believe that a good relationship that mutually benefits the suppliers and the surrounding communities recruited as workers is a key to achieving our performance target. This has become the foundation for the Company to prepare its business prospects in the future.

## Acknowledgments

On behalf of the Company, we would like to appreciate all stakeholders for the support, collaboration and trust. The Company will strive to deliver the best results through collaboration for better engagement with all stakeholders to achieve our goals. We believe that effective partnership and collaboration will enable us to contribute to the development of Indonesia and delivery of added values to the community, environment and economy.

# Performance Appraisal and Career Development

Performance appraisals for permanent employees are conducted through the Performance Appraisal Online application conducted by supervisors online by combining quantitative and qualitative-based assessment results based on their team's performance achievements. Each supervisor is responsible for determining and communicating the results of his/her team's performance appraisal and expected improvements for the next performance period through the Performance Appraisal process. The Performance Appraisal Policy and Procedure is contained in MOD-OD 004. Supervisors are also required to convey the Department's objectives to the team that are aligned with the Company's objectives. Performance evaluation is conducted through the Perform application with a personal feedback mechanism and is an input for the Employee Review process on the achievement of objectives (Key Performance Indicator-KPI), Leadership Model, career development, and future development planning. Performance appraisal results are used as the basis for mapping competencies, development needs, and promotions, especially at the Staff, Supervisor and Manager levels.

Based on the results of the performance appraisal in 2022, 363 employees were promoted, 38 employees from non-staff to staff, and 9 employees from supervisor level to managerial level. Follow-up performance appraisal to conduct competency mapping is accommodated through the Talent Management System application.

Selain itu, masih terdapat risiko-risiko lainnya yang kami hadapi, seperti risiko terkait dengan pemasok, kinerja keuangan, pemasaran, dan lainnya. Pengendalian risiko ekonomi dan LST, menjadi bagian dari penerapan tata kelola perusahaan yang baik (good corporate governance/GCG). Perseroan berupaya untuk meminimalkan risiko dengan cara mengefektifkan fungsi pengawasan dan pengendalian risiko, baik di lingkup operasional maupun fungsional secara berkala.

# Sustainability Risk Management

The Company carries out periodic economic and ESG risk identification and evaluation across its business activities. The parties that carry out these activities are the Internal Audit Unit, which then reports the results of risk management to the Audit Committee. The Board of commissioners specifically monitors risk management activities and delegates full authorities to the management to manage the arising risks, including ESG and other critical risks.

One of the risks that is mitigated is the risk in K3 management, such as ensuring that every employee can work safely so that productivity is maintained. As a labor heavy company, Wismilak is required to maintain a low turnover rate and carry out recruitment continuously. In addition, we consistently offer training and education programs to develop skillful and competent human resources. In addition, we continuously manage and mitigate various risks related to the environment so as not to damage the environment around the factory. Moreover, there are other risks that we face, including risks concerning suppliers, financial performance, marketing, and others. Further information on the risk profile and risk management is presented on 2022 Annual Report which is published separately.

Economic and ESG risk control has become a part good corporate governance (GCG). The Company strives to minimize risks through periodic effective risk monitoring and control across its operations and functions.

Dalam menjalankan kegiatan usaha, Wismilak menjunjung tinggi integritas dan etika bisnis. Implementasi integritas dan etika bisnis tersebut juga kami terapkan bagi seluruh pemangku kepentingan. Wismilak telah memiliki kebijakan yang jelas dalam setiap proses bisnis yang wajib didukung dan diterapkan oleh seluruh karyawan, maupun pemasok/mitra kerja yang berada di lingkungan Perseroan. Di samping itu, Wismilak selalu mematuhi regulasi yang berlaku di Indonesia serta menerapkan norma-norma etika bisnis yang berlaku universal.

# Praktik Antikorupsi

Sebagai bagian dari penerapan integritas dan etika bisnis, Perseroan menjalankan kebijakan antikorupsi di seluruh rantai nilai bisnisnya. Wismilak tidak menoleransi segala bentuk kecurangan, korupsi, maupun gratifikasi. Kebijakan tersebut didukung oleh pelaksanaan Kode Etik yang berlaku bagi seluruh karyawan. Selain itu, dalam dokumen Sistem Perilaku Perusahaan termuat uraian mengenai nilai-nilai kejujuran, kesopanan, dan integritas yang wajib dipatuhi oleh seluruh insan Wismilak. # Healthy Business Competition

In facing business competition in the cigarette industry, the Company seek to improve its operational performance by implementing the national and international best practices, standards, and ethical guidelines. We are committed to implementing healthy business competition with our competitors in marketing our product. This commitment engages and is supported by all parties in the Company to comply with the applicable policies, regulations, and code of conduct.

# Compliance and Business Ethics

In carrying out its business activities, Wismilak upholds integrity and business ethics. Integrity and business ethics are implemented to our stakeholders as well. Wismilak has set up clear policies for each business process that must be supported and implemented by all employees and suppliers/business partners within the premises of the Company. In addition, Wismilak strives to comply with the prevailing laws and regulations in Indonesia and to implement the universal norms of business ethics.

# Anti-corruption Practices

As a part of our integrity and business ethics, the Company implements anti-corruption policies across its business value chain. Wismilak carries out a zero tolerance policy against fraud, corruption, and gratification. This policy is supported by the execution of Code of Conduct by all employees. Anti-corruption and anti-fraud policies are set out in the Board Manual of the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors as well. In addition, the Corporate Behavior System document covers the details of honesty, respect, and integrity values to be implemented by all employees. To raise the awareness of integrity, the Company disseminates its code of conduct and behavior standards to the employees periodically through various communication channels.
